purpose: Test whether the frozen production action space contains at least one single-step primary candidate that improves each P1 false-finish target and passes the unchanged pre-Qwen hard gates before any C-ISO or T-TRAJ data are constructed.
interpretation_scope: Conclusions apply only to the frozen CORE3 source states, enumerator, tools, single-step budget, and primary action inventory. They are not a LEVIR-CD generalization result.

anchors.freeze_commit_policy: The manifest records implementation commit A only. Freeze commit B must be its direct child and is recorded only by external run receipts.

source_h0_retry3.source_state_policy: Every candidate resets independently to the exact cached H0 retry3 selected-step-zero T1/T2 semantic masks. No candidate starts from another candidate.

source_h1_retry3.provenance_policy: The frozen H0/H1 pair proves that H1 selected the same step-zero state and metrics as the H0 masks used for P2, while binding the two P1 false-finish targets to the completed H1 evaluation.
source_h1_retry3.pair_equivalence_requirement: The fixed CORE3 pair must bind independent H0 Job 53158 and H1 Job 53159 receipts, and the bound summaries/source metrics must show the same verifier-selected step and selected metrics for every sample.

action_enumeration_contract.authority: MaskPairProcessor.rebuild followed by attach_verifier_regions on the frozen masks, then tools.run_qwen3vl_p2_oracle.enumerate_oracle_actions
action_enumeration_contract.present_proposal_primary: one negative_point on the exactly one white target view at component_seed_pixels
action_enumeration_contract.present_proposal_diagnostic: one positive_point on the exactly one black target view at the same component_seed_pixels
action_enumeration_contract.scan_proposal_primary: one box action for each of t1 and t2 at box_pixels
action_enumeration_contract.action_spec_deduplication: exact candidate_id and exact sample/tier/region/action/target/geometry identity
action_enumeration_contract.candidate_state_deduplication: not used to reduce the preregistered action inventory; identical resulting masks remain separately auditable action outcomes

metric_contract.rate_contract: Every rate records numerator, denominator, and Wilson 95% interval; a zero denominator is represented by null rate and bounds.

decision_contract.allow_data_construction_if: test_1_1 and test_50_8 each have at least one primary beneficial candidate whose unchanged pre-Qwen hard gate passed
decision_contract.proceed_target: construct matched C-ISO and T-TRAJ data only after this condition passes
stop_if: either target has no primary beneficial candidate in the complete frozen inventory
either target has beneficial primary candidates but none pass the unchanged pre-Qwen hard gate
candidate generation or offline scoring evidence is incomplete or invalid
decision_contract.beneficial_but_hard_gated_policy: Report the action and gate reason for review; do not modify, relax, or retune the gate in this P2 run.
decision_contract.negative_result_interpretation: No reachability was observed only within this preregistered finite single-step action inventory; it is not proof that no useful action exists in a broader space.

canonical_json_contract.hash_scope: The entire parsed preregistration object; no field is excluded.
canonical_json_contract.serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) with no trailing newline.
